export class RefreshStore {
  private pendingRefreshRevision: number = 0
  private lastRefreshTimestamp: number = 0
  private retryDelayMilliseconds: number = 1000
  private maximumRefreshAttempts: number = 3
  private successfulRefreshCount: number = 0
  private configurationValue0: number = 0
  private configurationValue1: number = 0
  private configurationValue2: number = 0
  private configurationValue3: number = 0
  private configurationValue4: number = 0
  private configurationValue5: number = 0
  private configurationValue6: number = 0
  private configurationValue7: number = 0
  private configurationValue8: number = 0
  private configurationValue9: number = 0
  private configurationValue10: number = 0
  private configurationValue11: number = 0
  private configurationValue12: number = 0
  private configurationValue13: number = 0
  private configurationValue14: number = 0
  private configurationValue15: number = 0
  private adapter: RefreshAdapter
  private result: string = ''
  async dispatch(command: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.adapter.executeAction(command)
  }
  async refreshState(): Promise<void> {
    const latest = await this.adapter.loadCurrent()
    this.result = latest
  }
}

expansion.use_when: inspect ranking audit, full records, or one unresolved candidate
